author: Frank Asante Van Laarhoven

why_a_declaration_is_required.statement: Office has no intrinsic geometric boundary. Two rules for deriving one are refuted by measurement: the skyline buildings carry colliders, and they stand on a ground plane that reports floor in 723,135 of 723,135 coarse cells. Neither collidable geometry nor 'where the robot can stand' separates interior from exterior.
why_a_declaration_is_required.consequence: the collection region is DECLARED and recorded, not derived, and it is frozen before any candidate is enumerated

region_centre.basis: centroid of the union of the two office ceiling slabs, measured from the scene
region_centre.why_the_ceiling: the ceiling slabs sit directly above the office floor, so their footprint is a measurable proxy for the building interior. The floor itself is not usable for this: it is continuous with the exterior ground plane across the whole stage.
region_centre.not_chosen_by: route outcomes; no Office candidate has been enumerated at the time of freezing

window.derivation: max_path_m (40.0, frozen in CollectConfig) + footprint_radius (0.24, frozen in M3PRO)
window.guarantee: Euclidean displacement cannot exceed path length, so every point of any route no longer than max_path_m from a start inside this window lies inside it. The window cannot exclude a route the frozen contract would admit from such a start.

what_this_restricts.statement: starts and goals are sampled from within the window, so the Office candidate population is routes lying within the declared region rather than anywhere on the stage.
what_this_restricts.honest_consequence: the office ceiling union spans 94 m in y while the window spans 80.5 m, so part of the building's y-extent is outside the sampling region. This narrows the candidate population and is declared rather than hidden.
what_this_restricts.not_a_claim: this does not assert that the excluded area is untraversable, only that it is outside the declared BO-10 collection region

hospital_unaffected.statement: the occupancy window is OPT-IN and build_occupancy's default is unchanged.
hospital_unaffected.why_it_must_be: Hospital's frozen result was produced under the stage bound at 420 x 768. A window would give a different grid, and a different grid means different sampling, so the frozen result would no longer be re-derivable.

frozen_contract_unchanged.search: seed 0, budget 96, sample_episode_pair -- same as Hospital

non_claims: No route is admitted by this declaration.
Office data, if collected, is a collection-pipeline and loader-compatibility proof and is never relabelled as Hospital data.
